name: Fallen Ref Flag
hook: Tumble onto the turf and fling penalty flags straight from your back
tagline: A stunned referee gets knocked flat on the gridiron and furiously hurls yellow penalty laundry into the stadium rafters. Cashing out blows the official whistle and rolls straight into a timely commercial break. Crashing buries the entire field under a suffocating mountain of flags and thunderous booing.
